question: Sahel is an area in Africa that has lost a huge area of productive land in the last century due to excessive human activities and climate change. This area is a blaring example of _______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**desertification**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Desertification** is the process by which fertile land becomes desert, typically as a result of drought, deforestation, or inappropriate agriculture.
 
• The **Sahel** region in Africa has experienced significant desertification due to **excessive human activities and climate change**.
 
• Desertification leads to the loss of productive land, which has severe implications for the livelihood of the local population and the environment.
 
• Efforts to combat desertification include sustainable land management practices, reforestation, and policies aimed at reducing the impact of climate change.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD)** is an international agreement aimed at addressing desertification and mitigating the effects of drought.
 
• The Sahel region spans across several countries in Africa, including **Senegal, Mauritania, Mali, Burkina Faso, Niger, Nigeria, Chad, Sudan, and Eritrea**.
 
• Desertification in the Sahel has been exacerbated by factors such as overgrazing, deforestation for fuelwood, and unsustainable farming practices.
 
• Climate change has contributed to more frequent and severe droughts in the Sahel, further accelerating the desertification process.
 
• Community-based initiatives and international cooperation are essential in addressing the challenges posed by desertification in the Sahel.
